action_items: Ben kicks off the unmoderated IA study Monday with five participants
Ben shares the IA study highlights as a single-page document Thursday afternoon
Quentin holds engineering handoff until the IA study results land
Quentin finalizes loading-state annotations, dark-mode pass, and deep-link route list in the spec

decisions: Collapse 14 top-level settings entries into five groups: Account, Notifications, Privacy, Appearance, Advanced
Place 'export data' under Privacy in the new IA
notes: Top three search terms in research: delete account, notification frequency, export data. Region change and 2FA enrollment are the slow toggles needing loading states. Analytics opt-out default still open between research (default-off) and legal (default-on).
